interpretation: All arms solved every question in both replicates with valid supporting evidence and appropriate uncertainty.
No consistent tool-effort advantage was demonstrated for indexed or KG access.
KG replicate1 used four subject-filtered searches; neither KG agent used structured-state views.
All arms received the same descriptive project/alias catalog, so this is not unaided discovery of project organization.
Source integrity hashing and concurrent execution confound pure latency interpretation; no database-speed or model-token claim.
Synthetic templated background and ten correlated prompts limit generalization. No semantic embeddings or real personal-work data were evaluated.
